results.rationale: Consistency: Bottle body, droplets, reflections, base, wooden counter and tiled wall remain visually unchanged; cap completion is excluded. Instruction: Exposed neck threads are now covered by a complete blue ribbed cap with a solid top, matching the expected closed bottle; perfect compliance. Quality: Structure, lighting, perspective and plastic textures are coherent, with no noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: Bottle placement and wall layout are retained, but the lower bottle contours/reflections and the counter grain are visibly reworked. Instruction: A complete blue ribbed cap now covers the exposed threaded mouth; the bottle is fully closed as requested. Quality: Bottle and cap have coherent shapes, plausible highlights and natural surface textures; no noticeable structural or generation artifacts.

Consistency: Counter, tiles and overall composition remain consistent, but the bottle body is visibly broadened at the shoulders and its outline is altered. Instruction: A full ivory cap with a solid recessed top replaces the exposed mouth, completing the closure; no cap color was specified. Quality: Bottle and scene are coherent with plausible lighting, but the cap front has a small irregular notch and softened embossed texture.

Consistency: Wall/counter layout and bottle position persist, but the counter and wall textures become conspicuously mottled and the bottle base contours/reflections change. Instruction: A blue cap is added, but it sits tilted above separated stacked blue neck bands with a visible gap; a completed cap should seat coherently over the mouth, so the request is only partially fulfilled. Quality: The tilted cap and disconnected-looking neck bands create a clear structural flaw; coarse mottled surface texture also degrades the scene, although the bottle body remains recognizable.
